classes.name: com/mojang/blaze3d/audio/Listener
javadoc: The Listener class represents the listener in a 3D audio environment.
The listener's position and orientation determine how sounds are perceived by the listener.

methods.name: getGain
javadoc: {@return the current gain value of the listener}

methods.name: getListenerPosition
javadoc: {@return the current position of the listener in a 3D space}

methods.name: reset
javadoc: Resets the listener's position and orientation to default values.

methods.name: setGain
javadoc: Sets the listener's gain.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.javadoc: The gain to set for the listener.

methods.name: setListenerOrientation
javadoc: Sets the listener's orientation.

parameters.name: clientViewVector
parameters.javadoc: The view vector indicating the direction the listener is facing.

parameters.name: viewVectorRaised
parameters.javadoc: The up vector indicating the listener's "up" direction.

methods.name: setListenerPosition
javadoc: Sets the listener's position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.javadoc: A Vec3 representing the listener's position in 3D space.

classes.name: com/mojang/blaze3d/audio/OggAudioStream
javadoc: An implementation of the {@link AudioStream} interface that reads Ogg Vorbis audio data from an {@link InputStream}.

fields.name: EXPECTED_MAX_FRAME_SIZE
javadoc: The expected maximum frame size in bytes.

fields.name: audioFormat
javadoc: The audio format of the Ogg Vorbis stream.

fields.name: buffer
javadoc: The buffer used to read data from the input stream.

fields.name: handle
javadoc: The handle for the Ogg Vorbis stream.

fields.name: input
javadoc: The input stream containing the Ogg Vorbis data.

methods.name: close
javadoc: Closes the audio stream. This method frees any resources associated with the stream, such as the handle for the Ogg Vorbis stream and the memory used to store the input buffer.
@throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while closing the stream

methods.name: convertMono
javadoc: Converts mono audio data from the specified channel to a byte buffer and appends it to the specified output buffer.
The method reads samples from the channel and adds them to the output buffer until there are no more samples remaining in the channel.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.javadoc: the channel containing the mono audio data to convert

parameters.name: output
parameters.javadoc: the output buffer to which the converted audio data should be appended

methods.name: convertStereo
javadoc: Converts stereo audio data from the specified left and right channels to a byte buffer and appends it to the specified output buffer. The method reads samples from both channels and interleaves them in the output buffer until there are no more samples remaining in either channel.

parameters.name: leftChannel
parameters.javadoc: the channel containing the left audio data to convert

parameters.name: rightChannel
parameters.javadoc: the channel containing the right audio data to convert

parameters.name: output
parameters.javadoc: the output buffer to which the converted audio data should be appended

methods.name: forwardBuffer
javadoc: Forwards the buffer to the next Ogg packet boundary.

methods.name: getFormat
javadoc: {@return the {@linkplain AudioFormat} of the stream}

methods.name: read
javadoc: Reads audio data from the stream and returns a byte buffer containing at most the specified number of bytes.
The method reads audio frames from the stream and adds them to the output buffer until the buffer contains at least the specified number of bytes or the end fo the stream is reached.
@return a byte buffer containing at most the specified number of bytes to read
@throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while reading the audio data

parameters.name: size
parameters.javadoc: the maximum number of bytes to read

methods.name: readAll
javadoc: Reads all of the audio data from the stream and returns a byte buffer containing the entire audio data.
The method reads audio frames from the stream and adds them to the output buffer until the end of the stream is reached.
@return a byte buffer containing the entire audio data
@throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while reading the audio data

methods.name: readFrame
javadoc: Reads the next audio frame from the Ogg Vorbis stream.
@return {@code true} if an audio frame was successfully read, {@code false} if the end of the stream was reached
@throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while reading the audio data

parameters.name: output
parameters.javadoc: the output buffer to which the audio data should be written

methods.name: refillFromStream
javadoc: Refills the buffer with data from the input stream.
@return {@code true} if the buffer was successfully refilled, {@code false} if the end of the input stream was reached
@throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while reading the data from the input stream

classes.name: com/mojang/blaze3d/audio/OggAudioStream$OutputConcat
javadoc: An implementation of the {@link ByteBuffer} class that concatenates multiple byte buffers into a single buffer.
The class maintains a list of buffers and a byte count, and adds new data to the current buffer until it is full.
When the current buffer is full, it is added to the list and a new buffer is created. The `get()` method returns a single byte buffer containing all of the data from the list of buffers.

methods.name: createNewBuffer
javadoc: Creates a new buffer and sets it as the current buffer.

methods.name: get
javadoc: {@return a single byte buffer containing all of the data from the list of buffers}

methods.name: put
javadoc: Adds a sample to the current buffer. If the buffer is full, the buffer is added to the list of buffers and a new buffer is created.

parameters.name: sample
parameters.javadoc: the audio sample to add to the buffer

classes.name: com/mojang/blaze3d/audio/SoundBuffer
javadoc: The SoundBuffer class represents an audio buffer containing audio data in a particular format.
The audio data can be used to create an OpenAL buffer, which can be played in a 3D audio environment.

methods.name: discardAlBuffer
javadoc: Deletes the OpenAL buffer associated with this SoundBuffer, if it exists.

methods.name: getAlBuffer
javadoc: Returns an OptionalInt containing the OpenAL buffer handle for this SoundBuffer.
If the buffer has not been created yet, creates the buffer and returns the handle.
If the buffer cannot be created, returns an empty OptionalInt.
@return An OptionalInt containing the OpenAL buffer handle, or an empty OptionalInt if the buffer cannot be created.

methods.name: releaseAlBuffer
javadoc: Releases the OpenAL buffer associated with this SoundBuffer and returns it as an OptionalInt.
If no buffer has been created yet, returns an empty OptionalInt.
@return an {@linkplain OptionalInt} containing the OpenAL buffer handle, or an empty one, if the buffer has not been created
